from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router import Model, Provider, ProviderError
from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import normalize_content
from llm_router._internal.providers import qwenchat
from llm_router._internal.providers.base import ProviderCredential, ProviderRequest
from llm_router._internal.providers.qwenchat import QwenChatAdapter

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY[revision==1]")
async def test_qwenchat_aexecute_raises_provider_error_on_transport_failure(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    original_error = qwenchat.httpx.ConnectError("Connection refused")

    async def _mock_post(*_args: object, **_kwargs: object) -> object:
        raise original_error

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        qwenchat.httpx.AsyncClient,
        "post",
        _mock_post,
    )

    credential = ProviderCredential(
        key_id=1,
        env_var="CUSTOM_AUTH_ENV",
        value="auth-value",
    )
    request = ProviderRequest(
        request_id="req-1",
        provider=Provider.QWENCHAT,
        model=Model.QWEN_MAX_LATEST,
        provider_model="qwen-max-latest",
        credential=credential,
        messages=[normalize_content("test prompt")],
    )
    adapter = QwenChatAdapter(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8000/api")

    with pytest.raises(ProviderError, match=r"(?i)connection refused") as exc_info:
        await adapter.aexecute(request)

    assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is original_error
    assert exc_info.value.provider == Provider.QWENCHAT
    assert exc_info.value.model == Model.QWEN_MAX_LATEST
    assert exc_info.value.cause is not None
    assert exc_info.value.message is not None
    assert "connection refused" in exc_info.value.message.lower()
